scope: Native CAD simulated lift foundation only; keyboard and full directional acceptance require stage 2.

measurement.clearance: minimum native source-CAD sole world height minus environment origin
measurement.unloaded: vertical foot force <=5 N, from native foot_step_metrics
measurement.high_swing: reference_height >.022 m and reference_contact is false
measurement.slip: RMS horizontal speed of loaded feet during planned stance
measurement.stop: Mean speed over observed 18–20 s windows only; each counted episode must cover the window except at most one excluded terminal frame; missing coverage fails a separate rate gate

timeline.inplace: stand 0–1; walk with zero command 1–8; stand 8–20

control_contract.action: V5 leg control + guarded upper residuals; Kp70 upper, Kd8 waist only; native 100 Nm; no root wrench
control_contract.ankle_feedback: pitch/roll + 0.15 * body angular velocity, correction clipped to +/-0.15 rad; native left/right pitch signs respected
control_contract.observation_note: 110-D command observation retained; chest state observable from root IMU and waist q/qdot
control_contract.transition: continuous shared policy; no reset except episode failure or explicit restart

motor.reference_height: Actual source-CAD sole FK at every phase, not the nominal 6 cm command
motor.scope: Native contact-driven residual PPO; no body-aware IK override; gesture swing qdot feedforward verified in native ablation
motor.velocity_feedforward_reference: Adjacent nominal blended reference q; swing legs only; zero at reset and mode change

upper_pd.scope: Upper Kp70 retained, arms damping4; waist-only damping8, selected by two-seed native comparison.

upper_body.scope: V6r1 frozen control fork: Kp70 unchanged; waist damping8; contact/overshoot/angular energy costs and stage0 gesture rehearsal. All acceptance gates unchanged.

control_contract.height_target: Per-phase actual source-CAD FK recomputed from native bounded joint reference

measurement.timing: After native wrapped.step; exclude done, implicit reset and all subsequent first-episode samples
measurement.chest_tilt: Native torso up-axis inclination from world vertical; yaw invariant
measurement.angular_speed: Native torso local roll/pitch angular speed norm; yaw excluded; differs from older XYZ diagnostic
measurement.arm_reference: RMS joint position error against the current moving reference; gesture and recover only
measurement.controlled_return: Arm reference tracking during the final 250 ms of each left/right gesture; not a stand-hand comparison during the next gesture
measurement.early_return: Both hands versus stand-FK in pelvis coordinates, gesture end +0.8 to +1.5 s, before interactive WASD resume
measurement.tail: 18–20 s standing; RMS Euclidean distance per hand, not per-coordinate RMS
measurement.coverage: At least all prescribed window samples except one terminal frame per counted episode; failed first episodes cannot count as observed
measurement.aggregation: Equal episode mean-square weighting; peaks include partial first episodes; P95 over per-episode peaks; missing values remain null
